subject: Pricing qualification & cache assumptions — Finteq pilot next steps
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhao <claire@finteq.io>, Arjun Patel <arjun@finteq.io>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing qualification & cache assumptions — Finteq pilot next steps

Claire / Arjun — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on pricing inputs before I send a formal pilot proposal.

1) Volume profile you shared
- Monthly active users: 150k (approx)
- Avg session length: 3.2 turns, ~1,000 tokens generated per session overall (prompt + generation)
- Expected ramp: pilot month 1 -> ~0.5M tokens/day, month 3 -> ~2M tokens/day

2) Budget target
- You mentioned a pilot budget band of $8k–$12k/mo. You also said product team wants prototype economics at or below ~$700 effective per 1M tokens to make the business case.

3) Caching assumptions we discussed (need confirmation)
- Prefix cache (system + common prompt templates): conservative hit rate for pilot: 25%
- Session KV cache for multi-turn: conservative hit rate: 40% (higher for returning users)
- Combined effective hit: we applied a hybrid approach (not additive) — illustrative effective hit = 1 - ((1-0.25)*(1-0.40)) = ~55% for repeated interactions where both apply. For one-off ad-hoc prompts, assume ~10% prefix hit.

4) Pricing example (illustrative)
- Baseline model cost (hosted unit) we used: $1,200 per 1M tokens
- Effective cost with 25% prefix + 40% session KV (55% combined hit) -> effective model cost = $1,200 * (1 - 0.55) = $540 per 1M tokens
- Add infra/observability/pipeline & margin -> estimated bill to Finteq pilot = $700–$850 per 1M tokens (varies by sustained throughput and SLA).

Action items / asks
- Claire: confirm the pilot budget band you want us to target ($8k–$12k/mo) and whether $700/1M is an acceptable target for the internal stakeholders.
- Arjun: can you share a small sample of typical prompts (anon) or the most common prefix templates so we can run a quick prefix-hitrate estimate? A 200–500 line sample is ideal.
- We’ll produce a short XLS with scenarios (attached v1) and a recommended pilot scope if you confirm the budget target.

Thanks — happy to hop on another 20-min sync if helpful.

— Monica
Monica Patel | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: RDW_Finteq_cost_estimate_v1.xlsx, Finteq-mdap-prefix-sample.txt

From: Claire Zhao <claire@finteq.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun@finteq.io>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing qualification & cache assumptions — Finteq pilot next steps

Thanks Monica — that summary looks right. A couple quick clarifications:
- Pilot budget: we can stretch to $15k for month 1 if the ROI signal is strong, but prefer $8k–$12k as the steady pilot band.
- The $700/1M target is what the product lead asked for. She said anything below $800/1M makes the business case likely.
- We can provide a sanitized prefix sample — Arjun will send tonight.

Please include an option that assumes a low prefix hit scenario (10% combined) so we can see worst-case economics. Also include a small table that shows how effective $/1M moves with 10/25/50/70% combined hit rates.

Claire
Claire Zhao | Head of Product, Finteq Solutions
claire@finteq.io | +1 (212) 555-0199

---

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhao <claire@finteq.io>
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun@finteq.io>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing qualification & cache assumptions — Finteq pilot next steps

Claire — thanks for the quick confirmation and helpful guardrails. Attached is RDW_Finteq_cost_estimate_v1.xlsx; highlights below (showing the table you asked for).

- Baseline unit: $1,200/1M tokens (no cache)
- Effective $/1M by combined hit rate:
  - 10% -> $1,080
  - 25% -> $900
  - 50% -> $600
  - 70% -> $360

Notes: these are model-only effective costs. We also show two bill-to-customer scenarios: (A) lean pilot (no SLA, shared infra) -> +15% markup, (B) production pilot with 99th percentile latency SLA and monitoring -> +40% markup. That yields the $700–$850 band I mentioned for the 50% hit scenario.

Next steps I propose:
1) Arjun sends prefix sample (tonight) -> we run a quick hit-rate sweep and send an updated table by EOD Monday.
2) If the economics look good, sign pilot SOW (4 weeks, $10k credit toward usage) -> pilot scope: integration + 2-week ramp + 2-week evaluation.
3) Optional: limited-time pilot pricing (20% off bill rate) if you commit to an enterprise evaluation within 90 days.

Can you confirm which pilot billing scenario you prefer (lean vs production)? If you want, we can also provide a side-by-side showing token spend vs. user growth to map to your $8k–$15k budgets.

— Monica

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>

Subject: RE: Pricing qualification & cache assumptions — Finteq pilot next steps

Quick internal: conservative flag on baseline. If we price baseline model at $1,200/1M and offer a 20% pilot discount off the bill rate (not model cost), margins should still be within acceptable range for a call-to-prod motion. Recommend we present both the 20% pilot discount and the lean vs production markup so Claire can see clear tradeoffs.

I’ll standby for the prefix sample and can run a small prefix-hit simulation (scripted) when Arjun drops the file.

— Sean
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
